currentParagraphText: “I know it may be hard to relate,” Caleb spoke again after a while. “Trying to get more powerful just feels natural to you. Like it’s just what you’re meant to do. But Mom and Dad aren’t like that, and I don’t want to force them into being like that... and I know that neither do you.”
